title: Xanthe and the Drop
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Ishikawa, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
